title: Cuadra San Cristóbal
notes: For the Egerström family, with Andrés Casillas
address: Los Clubes, Atizapán de Zaragoza, State of Mexico

detail.intro: House, stables, pools and riding ground for Folke Egerström at Los Clubes, designed with Andrés Casillas. Pink and purple walls enclose a courtyard where water pours from a spout into a pool for the horses. The most photographed of Barragán's late works.
